rule: CLAUDE.md TABOO 0.35 rule 8: audio from the 99 repos is a spectral reference only (envelope, T60, IR) and never a sample in the game. No audio file ships.

units.t60_s: Schroeder backward integration, fit -5..-25 dB (T20) or -5..-35 dB (T30); T10 is partial
units.edc_db: 12 points of the energy decay curve from the peak to where the decay meets the noise floor
units.envelope_db: 16 max-pooled points over the duration, dB relative to the peak (2 ms blocks)
units.bands_db: octave-band energy relative to the total

lake.water.use: surface and shore water, room tone of the lake

lake.splash.use: dive_synth.gd event_take, fish at the lens

road.animals.use: horses, camels, sheep of the shepherd (node 33)

road.caravan.use: carts and harness of the caravan road

road.breath.use: timbre only; timing stays with hesychasm module
